# HEM v0.7.3 — Prepare for arrival availability and compact help

- Fixes Prepare for arrival staying disabled while the dashboard confirms Away when Home Assistant omits its optional frontend entity-registry metadata. The card now also accepts the owner verified by HEM's authenticated dashboard API, scoped to the selected home and current connection.
- Keeps the native button availability, household-presence checks, control ownership and existing device protections. Unknown presence still blocks preparation; a response from another home or an old connection cannot enable it.
- Shortens the Prepare tooltip in English, Greek and German. It shows one description when available or the current blocking reason when unavailable, without repeating the action and purpose. The active Cancel action no longer repeats its name.
- Adds production-card regression coverage for absent/incomplete metadata, multiple homes, conflicting identities, delayed responses, reconnects, presence changes and concise tooltips.

Install the update through HACS and reload the dashboard after updating HEM.
